CheckTitle: Log profile captures all activity log categories
Description: Verify that Azure Monitor log profiles are configured to export all activity log categories.
Risk: Incomplete activity logs may prevent detection of suspicious activities.

Code.CLI: az monitor log-profiles create --name default --categories Write Delete Action --days 365 --enabled true --location eastus --locations global eastus westus --storage-account-id <storage-account-id>

Recommendation.Text: Update log profiles to include 'Write', 'Delete', and 'Action' categories.
